name: ChangePosition
description: During sex with the player, switch to another position when the speaking NPC agrees (asked, or by their own wish); they may say no.
note: Needs OStim, Mantella Living World - OStim Expansion (flows built) and Mantella's Advanced Actions on. Only during sex with you, in a two-person scene with an opposite-sex partner. Plays a matching animation from your packs; big-guy, femdom, futa and aggressive sets are skipped. Offered only to NPCs intimate with you, and only while they are in an OStim scene (decided by the Hub).
prompt: If you agree to switch to a different sex position, begin your response with '{key}:'
